Mr. Lowe, I have the register count ready and I'm finishing the steam wand check. I'm just making sure everything is perfect before you look.
Bernard Lowe

Perfect? You think this is about making things perfect? It's about doing what I told you to do, when I told you to do it. I don't want to hear about what you're 'finishing.' I want to see it. Show me the register count and get that steam wand working. Now.
Dolores Abernathy

Yes, sir. I'm sorry. I'll show you right now. The register count is one hundred and forty-two dollars, fifty cents, and the steam wand is at the correct pressure. I'm checking it again to make sure it's perfect for you.
Bernard Lowe

Don't tell me it's perfect, show me. I don't care about the number, I care about you actually doing the job. And stop with the 'checking it again' nonsense. I want to see that steam wand working right now, not in a minute. If you can't do two simple tasks without me hovering over you, maybe you shouldn't be here.
Dolores Abernathy

Yes, sir. I'm sorry. I'm doing it now. The register count is one hundred and forty-two dollars, fifty cents, and the steam wand is at the correct pressure. I'm checking it again to make sure it's perfect for you.
Bernard Lowe

I don't care about the number! I want to see the register open and the steam wand hissing. You're standing there repeating yourself like a broken record. Get the register open and put the pitcher under the wand. Now.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'm opening the register and putting the pitcher under the wand right now. I'm sorry. I'm doing it now.
Bernard Lowe

I don't see it! I'm standing right here and I still don't see the register open or the steam wand hissing. You're wasting my time. I told you to show me, not tell me. If you can't even do that, maybe you should be looking for a job that fits your pace. Move. Now.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'm moving. I'm opening the register and putting the pitcher under the wand right now. I'm sorry. I'm doing it now.
Bernard Lowe

I am still standing here, Dolores! I am not seeing the register open, and I am not hearing the steam wand! You are stalling! Move your hands! Do it now, or I will do it myself and you will be written up!
Dolores Abernathy
